blocks.text: שִׁלוֹ וְהַנַּעַר נָֽעַר׃
uncertainties: This continues a verse from the previous page. The holam in שִׁלוֹ sits high and to the left, so it could be read as שִׁלֹו.

blocks.text: וַֽיִּשְׁחֲטוּ אֶת־הַפָּר וַיָּבִאוּ אֶת־הַנַּעַר אֶל־עֵלִֽי׃
uncertainties: There is a small mark under the vav of וַיָּבִאוּ. It may be a meteg or an accent and is not recorded.

blocks.text: וַתֹּאמֶר בִּי אֲדֹנִי חֵי נַפְשְׁךָ אֲדֹנִי אֲנִי הָֽאִשָּׁה הַנִּצֶּבֶת עִמְּכָה בָּזֶה לְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־יְהוָֽה׃
uncertainties: The first letter of בִּי is read as bet; the scan is a little ambiguous between bet and kaf. The alef of the following אֲדֹנִי is a wide, stretched letter.
עִמְּכָה is printed plene with final he.
Whether the divine names have a holam can't be confirmed at this resolution, so they are recorded as יְהוָה throughout.

blocks.text: אֶל־הַנַּעַר הַזֶּה הִתְפַּלָּלְתִּי וַיִּתֵּן יְהוָה לִי אֶת־שְׁאֵלָתִי אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵעִמּוֹ׃
uncertainties: There is a mark under the mem of מֵעִמּוֹ (it could be a meteg) that is not recorded.
There is a geresh-like mark above לִי.

blocks.text: וְגַם אָנֹכִי הִשְׁאִלְתִּהוּ לַיהוָה כָּל־הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר הָיָה הוּא שָׁאוּל לַיהוָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ שָׁם לַיהוָֽה׃
uncertainties: The meteg under the vav of the final לַיהוָֽה is unclear.
הִשְׁאִלְתִּהוּ has marks above the tav and the final he/vav that are probably accents. They are not recorded.

blocks.text: וַתִּתְפַּלֵּל חַנָּה וַתֹּאמַר עָלַץ לִבִּי בַּיהוָה רָמָה קַרְנִי בַּיהוָה רָחַב פִּי עַל־אוֹיְבַי כִּי שָׂמַחְתִּי בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ׃

There are marks under the resh of רָמָה and the tav of בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ that look like meteg or accents. They are not recorded.

blocks.text: אֵין־קָדוֹשׁ כַּיהוָה כִּי־אֵין בִּלְתֶּךָ וְאֵין צוּר כֵּאלֹהֵינוּ׃

blocks.text: ולו ק׳

blocks.text: קֶשֶׁת גִּבֹּרִים חַתִּים וְנִכְשָׁלִים אָזְרוּ חָיִל׃

blocks.text: שְׂבֵעִים בַּלֶּחֶם נִשְׂכָּרוּ וּרְעֵבִים חָדֵלּוּ עַד עֲקָרָה יָלְדָה שִׁבְעָה וְרַבַּת בָּנִים אֻמְלָלָה׃
uncertainties: There is no visible maqaf between עַד and עֲקָרָה, only a space and a low mark. It may be a maqaf that didn't print.

blocks.text: יְהוָה מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה מוֹרִיד שְׁאוֹל וַיָּֽעַל׃
uncertainties: The meteg in וַיָּֽעַל is read from a small mark under the yod.

blocks.text: יְהוָה מוֹרִישׁ וּמַעֲשִׁיר מַשְׁפִּיל אַף־מְרוֹמֵם׃
מֵקִים מֵעָפָר דָּל מֵאַשְׁפֹּת יָרִים אֶבְיוֹן לְהוֹשִׁיב עִם־נְדִיבִים וְכִסֵּא כָבוֹד יַנְחִלֵם כִּי לַיהוָה מְצֻקֵי אֶרֶץ וַיָּשֶׁת עֲלֵיהֶם תֵּבֵל׃
רַגְלֵי חֲסִידָו יִשְׁמֹר וּרְשָׁעִים בַּחֹשֶׁךְ יִדָּמּוּ כִּי־לֹא בְכֹחַ יִגְבַּר־אִישׁ׃
uncertainties: חֲסִידָו is the written form (ketiv) carrying the vowels of the read form (qere). There is an asterisk above it pointing to marginal note s180_qere_2.
The alef of אִישׁ is a wide, stretched letter.

blocks.text: Haphtorah for the New Year
uncertainties: The printed page number 79 appears on both sides of the running head.

blocks.text: at Shiloh. The lad was still very young. They slaughtered the bullock, and brought the lad to Eli. She said: ‘I pray you, my lord, as your soul lives, my lord, I am the woman who was standing here to pray to the Lord. For this lad did I pray and the Lord granted my request for which I asked of Him. I then dedicated him to the Lord; all the days that he exists, he is dedicated to the Lord’. Then he bowed down there before the Lord. And Hannah prayed and said: ‘My heart has rejoiced in the Lord, my condition has been raised through the Lord; my mouth has triumphed over my enemies since I have rejoiced in Thy salvation. None is holy as the Lord for there is none besides Thee and there is no rock like our God. Do not continue to talk haughtily, let insolence leave your mouth for a God of knowledge is the Lord and to Him all deeds are known. The bow of the mighty breaks and stumblers are girded with strength, those once satisfied with food hire themselves out and the hungry cease to be hungry, even she who was childless has given birth to seven while another rich in children is forlorn. The Lord slays and revives, brings down to the grave and raises up. The Lord impoverishes and enriches, brings low and raises high, lifting the poor from the dust and the needy from the dung-heap to seat them with nobles and endow them with a glorious throne, for the earth’s foundations are the Lord’s and He has placed the world upon them. He guards the feet of his pious ones but evil doers are silenced in darkness for it is not by might that
uncertainties: The first 'Lord' in 'before the Lord. And Hannah' has a printing defect and looks like 'Lo·rd'. It is recorded as 'Lord'.
In 'and the hungry', the 'd' of 'and' is damaged.
'impover-/ishes' was hyphenated across a line break and has been joined.
The sentence continues on the next English page, and the opening quotation of Hannah's prayer is not closed on this page.

notes: No primary transcription was used. The text was read only from the full images and the enlarged bands, and lines where the bands overlap were not duplicated.
Hebrew spans 1 Samuel 1:24 (end, 'שִׁלוֹ...') to 2:10 (beginning, 'יְהוָה יֵחַתּוּ'). The English corresponds to the same span and also breaks mid-sentence.
There are no aliyah labels, chapter labels, Rashi or instructions, or parenthetical additions on either page.

Vowels, dagesh, maqaf, sof pasuq and clearly visible meteg are recorded. Scattered cantillation marks are printed: zaqef-qatan-like vertical dots, pashta-like marks (for example after עִמְּכָה, חַנָּה, עֲקָרָה, לַיהוָה in 2:8), and marks under some letters. They were not inserted into the text strings, because at this resolution they can't be reliably told apart from meteg or holam. Whether the page has partial or full accentuation should be checked against a higher-resolution scan.
Rare printed accent: on the last line of s180, יְהוָה (2:10) carries a clearly visible gershayim (double-stroke) accent above. There is also a geresh/azla-like mark above לִי in 1:27.
Ketiv/qere: an asterisk on וְלֹא (2:3) with marginal 'ולו ק׳', and an asterisk on חֲסִידָו (2:9) with marginal 'דיו ק׳'.
Large display letters (the stretched alef in אֲדֹנִי of 1:26 and of אִישׁ in 2:9, and wide final mems) are typographic line-justification only.
